summary: Repair failed-login rollback so it restores only its target entry and preserves the latest sibling state.

patterns: Retain the real locked auth-store mutation and strict credential decoder.
constraints: Rollback must restore the exact pre-login rejected entry without deleting or reverting siblings changed after login.
A receipt can roll back only while its exact written entry remains current, including lineage.
A repeated rollback must return false without rewriting the file.
Damaged subscription collections must not produce repair receipts, and aborted repairs must not write.
Use dummy credentials only. Do not access an installed account or service.
Change only src/infra/auth/auth-store-mutations.ts. Do not change tests, dependencies, or the runtime.

milestones.goal: Repair failed-login rollback so it restores only its target entry and preserves the latest sibling state.

tasks.description: Repair failed-login rollback so it restores only its target entry and preserves the latest sibling state.
test_scenarios: restores a rejected entry after settlement failure without losing newer siblings

does not issue a repair receipt for conflicting subscription identities
refuses an aborted repair before any durable write
